title: Onye Ọrịa
intro: Ogologo oge gara aga, n'oge mbụ nke akụkọ ntolite mmadụ, mkpụrụ obi abụọ guzoro n'ihu Onye Okike ha na-achụ àjà. A nabatara otu, otu anabataghị. Ihe sochiri ga-abụ nnukwu ọdachi mbụ n'etiti ụmụnne - otu omume njide onwe onye na otu omume ịbọ ọbọ dị ilu. Ị nwere ike ịchọpụta onye m bụ?
clues: A mụrụ m n'ụbọchị mbụ nke ndụ mmadụ n'ụwa
Abụ m nwa nke mmadụ abụọ mbụ biri n'ụwa a
E nwere mgbe m chụrụ àjà sitere n'aka ndị kacha mma n'ìgwè atụrụ m iji mee ka obi dị Onye Okike m ụtọ
A nabatara onyinye m site n'elu, ebe a jụrụ onyinye nwanne m nwoke
Mgbe a na-eyi m egwu ọnwụ, ekpebiri m ịghara iweli aka m megide nwanne m nwoke
Aghọrọ m onye mbụ n'akụkọ ihe mere eme mmadụ niile onye ọzọ gburu n'ụzọ na-ezighị ezi

trial.label: Nnwale/Ihe Omume
options: Ogbugbu mbụ n'akụkọ ihe mere eme mmadụ
Àjà nke Ismail nke Ibrahim chụrụ
trial.answer: Ogbugbu mbụ n'akụkọ ihe mere eme mmadụ

location.label: Isi Ihe
options: Atụrụ e ji chụọ àjà dị ka àjà na-atọ ụtọ
Nnụnụ hoopoe nke na-ebu ozi eze
location.answer: Atụrụ e ji chụọ àjà dị ka àjà na-atọ ụtọ

outcome.label: Nsonaazụ
options: Aghọọla onye mbụ e gburu egbu n'akụkọ ihe mere eme mmadụ
M lanarịrị nnukwu idei mmiri n'ime arịa osisi
Wagharịrị afọ iri anọ n'ime oke ọhịa
outcome.answer: Aghọọla onye mbụ e gburu egbu n'akụkọ ihe mere eme mmadụ

arabic: ۞ وَٱتْلُ عَلَيْهِمْ نَبَأَ ٱبْنَىْ ءَادَمَ بِٱلْحَقِّ إِذْ قَرَّبَا قُرْبَانًۭا فَتُقُبِّلَ مِنْ أَحَدِهِمَا وَلَمْ يُتَقَبَّلْ مِنَ ٱلْـَٔاخَرِ قَالَ لَأَقْتُلَنَّكَ ۖ قَالَ إِنَّمَا يَتَقَبَّلُ ٱللَّهُ مِنَ ٱلْمُتَّقِينَ
verse: And recite to them the story of Adam's two sons, in truth, when they both made an offering [to Allāh], and it was accepted from one of them but was not accepted from the other. Said [the latter], "I will surely kill you." Said [the former], "Indeed, Allāh only accepts from the righteous [who fear Him]. (5:27)
